name: mcp-server-management
description: Install and configure MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for Claude Desktop on Windows. Covers installation workflows, claude_desktop_config.json management, MCP registry patterns, and the three CLI tools: Desktop Commander, Win-CLI, and Claude Code MCP. Use when: installing MCP servers, configuring Claude Desktop, choosing between MCP CLI tools, managing MCP registries, or troubleshooting MCP server not starting, tool not found, spawn ENOENT errors.
